hook: Mind (意) facing toward (向) something: the way your thoughts lean, your intention.
Move (移) and go (行): shifting over from an old system to a new one.
Clothes (衣) you dress up (装) in: a costume or outfit.
Different (異) sex (性): the opposite sex.
Traces (跡) left behind (遺) by old peoples: historic ruins.
Rely on (依) something to exist (存): dependence.
Put out (出) a topic or question (題): setting questions for a test.
Go out (出) and move (動): police or firefighters heading into action.
Money going out (出) for costs (費): expenses.
Put out (出) goods (品): showing items at an exhibition or sale.
The main (主) one who guides (導): taking the lead.
Main (主) duty (任): the person in charge.
Head (首) and brain (脳) of a group: top leaders, like at a summit.
Protect (守) and prepare (備): defense, like fielding in baseball.
Hand (手) method (法): your technique, the way you do it.
Tree (樹) + tree (木): trees and shrubs.
Stand up (立) firm like a tree (樹): to set up, like a new record.
Semi (準) express (急): a train a bit slower than an express.
準 means standard: to follow the standard, be treated in line with a rule.
Upper (上) rank (位): a higher position.
Put up (上) a performance (演) on stage: staging a play.
Below (下) the castle (城): the town around a castle.
Erase (消) and remove (去): deleting data.
The sky (空) up above (上): the air high over a place.
Crash (衝) and strike (撃): a shock or impact.
Shine light (照) on things to see if they match (合): checking, verifying.
称 means name, call: to call yourself something.
Circumstances (情) and forces (勢): how things stand right now.
Fade (消) or breathe (息): news of whether someone is alive and well.
Accept (承) and say yes (諾): consent.
Image (象) as a sign (徴): a symbol, like a dove for peace.
Small (小) child (児) department (科): pediatrics.
A person (人) you use (使用) for work: a servant or employee.
Hot (熱) feelings (情): passion.
Give way (譲) a step (歩): to make a concession.
Go up (上) onto land (陸): landing from the sea.
Steam (蒸) it, then collect (溜) the drops: distillation.
Encourage (奨) and urge on (励): promoting something.
Remove (除) to the outside (外): to exclude.
Land (地) where people (民) are planted (植): a colony.
Job (職) duties (務): your work responsibilities.
All (諸) of you, sirs (君): a speech opener like 'Gentlemen!'.
Go (行) slowly (徐): the road sign word for driving slowly.
Place (所) + hold (持): what you hold on you, possession.
The place (所) you belong (属) to: your team or company.
Deal with (処) and put in place (置): taking measures, medical treatment.
Place (所) + fixed (定): the set, prescribed one, like the fixed form.
That which (所) you get (得): your income.
Deal with (処) by punishment (罰): punishment.
First (初) printing (版): the first edition.
Book (書) review (評): a book review.
Deal with (処) and divide (分): getting rid of things, or a penalty.
Ordinary (庶) people (民): the common people.
Ordinary (庶) tasks (務): general office affairs.
That which (所) you have (有): ownership.
Stand (立) by yourself (自): independence.
記 means write down, as in 日記 (diary): to note something down.
Point (指) and order (令): a command, instructions.
陣 has a cart (車) inside: war carts lined up in battle formation.
Advance (進) and change (化): evolution.
A person's (人) standing or quality (格): personality, character.
Examine (審) and discuss (議): deliberation, like in parliament.
Sash (紳) wearing man (士): a gentleman.
Person (者) who believes (信): a believer.
True (真) gem (珠): a pearl.
Advance (進) out (出): moving into a new market or area.
Heart (心) feelings (情): how you feel inside.
God (神) and holy (聖): sacred.
Friendly (親) and good (善): goodwill between countries.
True (真) appearance (相): the real truth of what happened.
Swift (迅) and fast (速): quick, prompt.
Human (人) body (体): the human body.
New (新) build (築): a newly built house.
Literally 'inside the heart' (心中): lovers proving their true hearts by dying together.
Offer (呈) forward (進): presenting a gift.
Advance (進) and unfold (展): progress, development.
God's (神) hall (殿): a temple building.
Degree (度) of advance (進): how far along you are.
Shake (振) and move (動): vibration.
Trust (信) and entrust (任): confidence in someone.
God's (神) secret (秘): a mystery.
Hug (抱) the bitter (辛) stuff: patience, putting up with hardship.
Persons (人) and citizens (民): the people, the public.
Invade (侵) and seize (略): aggression, invasion.
Water (水) source (源): where a river starts.
Push (推) forward (進): propulsion, driving a plan ahead.
Infer (推) and measure (測): a guess.
Water (水) field (田): a rice paddy.
Infer (推) by logic (理): reasoning, also detective stories.
Number (数) word (詞): a numeral.
Revere (崇) and bow (拝): worship.
Set firmly (据) and attach (付): to install.
据 means set firmly in place: to place, to set.
健 means healthy, as in 健康: growing up healthy and sound.
濯 is the wash in 洗濯 (laundry): to rinse.
Clothes (衤) + stay (居): the part of clothes that stays low, the hem.
Plain (素) fast (早い): simply very quick.
清 means pure, clear: make it clear, like clearing your ears to listen.
済 means finished, as in 済み (done): to get it done.
擦 means rub: things rubbing together, chafing.
Life (生) raised (育): growth of plants or animals.
Grow up (成) and raise (育): growing up, raising.
Right (正) and righteous (義): justice.
Plan (計) for living (生): livelihood.
Political (政) power (権): the government in power.
Star (星) seats (座): a constellation.
Control (制) and judge (裁): sanctions, punishment.
Political (政) plans (策): policy.
Life (生) and death (死).
Quiet (静) and stopped (止): standing still.
Become (成) ripe (熟): maturity.
Green (青) spring (春): the springtime of life, youth.
Clean (清) and pure (純): innocent.
Holy (聖) book (書): the Bible.
Correct (正) and usual (常): normal.
制 means control: to control, to hold back.
整 means put in order: neat and orderly.
Abundant (盛) dressing up (装): wearing your finest clothes.
Thriving (盛) and big (大): grand, magnificent.
Clear (清) and muddy (濁): good and bad together.
Make rules (制) and fix (定) them: to enact a law.
Quiet (静) + like (的): static, not moving.
Make (製) iron (鉄): ironmaking.
Clear (晴) sky (天): fine weather.
Right (正) and fitting (当): proper, justified.
Conquer (征) and make submit (服): conquest.
Making (製) method (法): a recipe or manufacturing method.
Fine (精) and dense (密): precise, detailed.
Tax (税) work (務) office (署): the tax office.
Force (勢) and power (力): influence.
急 means hurry: to rush someone.
Person (亻) + young soldier (卆, a form of 卒): a man's son, 'my boy'.
Responsibility (責) and duty (務): an obligation.
Words (辞) for the world (世): polite flattery, as in お世辞.
One generation (世) tied by one belt (帯): a household.
Cut (切) open (開): a surgical incision.
So real (実) it cuts (切) you: urgent and serious.
Join (接) and touch (触): contact.
Connecting (接続) word (詞): a conjunction.
Bend (折) toward the middle (衷): blending two styles, a compromise.
Printing (版) is cut off (絶): out of print.
Set up (設) and stand (立): founding a company.
The world's (世) opinion (論): public opinion.
Fine (繊) threads (維): fiber.
Completely (全) feeling good (快): full recovery.
Proclaim (宣) the teaching (教): missionary work.
War (戦) disaster (災): war damage.
Specialize (専) and study (修): specializing in one subject.
War (戦) art (術): tactics.
Dive under (潜) water (水): diving.
Fully (全) thriving (盛): the peak of prosperity.
Previous (先) generation (代): the one before you.
先 means before: the other day, a little before now.
First (先) to arrive (着): first come, first served.
Before (先) heaven (天, nature) shapes you: something you are born with.
The road (途) ahead (前): future prospects.
War (戦) and fight (闘): combat.
Dive (潜) in (入): sneaking in.
Ship (船) + big ship (舶): ships.
All (全) destroyed (滅): wiped out.
Occupy (占) territory (領): military occupation.
Good (善) and fine (良): good-natured.
War (戦) power (力): fighting strength.
Earlier (前) example (例): a precedent.
Things that answer (応) each other (相): suitable, fitting.
Whole (総) meeting (会): a general meeting.
Create (創) a publication (刊): launching a magazine.
Mixed (雑) trees (木): assorted small trees.
Early (早) and urgent (急): needed right now.
Fast (早) and hurried (急): same word as そうきゅう, urgent.
Increase (増) strength (強): reinforce.
Gather all (総) together (合): synthesis, overall.
Search (捜) and seek (索): a search for someone missing.
Storehouse (蔵) minister (相): the Finance Minister, keeper of the treasury.
Increase (増) and advance (進): a boost, like to your appetite.
Facing (対) each other (相): relative, judged against something else.
Grand (壮) and big (大): magnificent.
Noise (騒) and movement (動): a riot, a fuss.
Meet with (遭) hardship (難): an accident, like being lost at sea or in the mountains.
The place (場) where prices meet (相): the market price.
Fit out (装) and prepare (備): equipment.
Create (創) and set up (立): founding.
Urge (促) forward (進): promotion, speeding up.
即 means right up against: to fit closely to, like the facts.
Bundle (束) and tie (縛): restraint.
Side (側) face (面): a side or aspect.
損 means loss, damage: to harm.
Raw (素) material (材): raw material.
Block (阻) and stop (止): prevent.
Sue (訴) and dispute (訟): a lawsuit.
Arrange (措) and place (置): measures taken.
No (無い) warmth or interest (素っ気): cold and curt.
Outside (外) direction (方): look the other way, as in そっぽを向く.
Prepare (備) and attach (付): to install equipment.
備 means prepared: to be equipped with.
具 means tool, equipment: to be furnished with.
聳 means tower high: mountains rising tall into the sky.
Turn your back (背) on something: to go against.
Water (氵) + nine (九) + wood (木): soaking cloth to dye it.
反 means bend back: to warp or curve back.
